basics.name: Eugenia Alleva, MD, MSc
basics.label: Assistant Professor; Associate Scientific Director of AI-Ready Mount Sinai
basics.summary: I am an Assistant Professor at the Dept of AI and Human Health and Obstetrics, Gynecology, and Reproductive Science at the Icahn School of Medicine at Mount Sinai. I am also the Associate Scientific Director of AI-Ready Mount Sinai, a large-scale institutional initiative to create a research-ready data ecosystem for AI innovation across the Mount Sinai Health System. My research focuses on developing and applying machine learning and artificial intelligence methods to women's health, with a focus on menstrual health and disorders.
